passages.text: How lonely lies the city, once so full of people! She who was great among the nations has become a widow. The princess of the provinces has become a slave.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem was once a great city.
She was full of people.
Now she sits alone.
She was powerful among the nations.
Now she is like a widow.
She was a princess over many provinces.
Now she has become a slave.
passages.original: אֵיכָ֣ה׀ יָשְׁבָ֣ה בָדָ֗ד הָעִיר֙ רַבָּ֣תִי עָ֔ם הָיְתָ֖ה כְּאַלְמָנָ֑ה רַּבָּ֣תִי בַגּוֹיִ֗ם שָׂרָ֙תִי֙ בַּמְּדִינ֔וֹת הָיְתָ֖ה לָמַֽס׃ס

passages.text: She weeps aloud in the night, with tears upon her cheeks. Among all her lovers there is no one to comfort her. All her friends have betrayed her; they have become her enemies.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
Jerusalem was once full of people.
Now Jerusalem is alone.
She cries loudly at night.
Tears run down her cheeks.
No one comforts her.
None of her lovers help her.
All her friends have turned against her.
Her friends have become her enemies.
passages.original: בָּכ֨וֹ תִבְכֶּ֜ה בַּלַּ֗יְלָה וְדִמְעָתָהּ֙ עַ֣ל לֶֽחֱיָ֔הּ אֵֽין־ לָ֥הּ מְנַחֵ֖ם מִכָּל־ אֹהֲבֶ֑יהָ כָּל־ רֵעֶ֙יהָ֙ בָּ֣גְדוּ בָ֔הּ הָ֥יוּ לָ֖הּ לְאֹיְבִֽים׃ס

passages.text: Judah has gone into exile under affliction and harsh slavery; she dwells among the nations but finds no place to rest. All her pursuers have overtaken her in the midst of her distress.
passages.sermon:
Judah is a nation.
Judah has gone into exile.
Judah suffers great affliction.
Judah endures harsh slavery.
Judah now lives among foreign nations.
Judah cannot find any place to rest.
Judah’s pursuers have caught her.
They overtook her while she was in distress.
passages.original: גָּֽלְתָ֨ה יְהוּדָ֤ה מֵעֹ֙נִי֙ וּמֵרֹ֣ב עֲבֹדָ֔ה הִ֚יא יָשְׁבָ֣ה בַגּוֹיִ֔ם לֹ֥א מָצְאָ֖ה מָנ֑וֹחַ כָּל־ רֹדְפֶ֥יהָ הִשִּׂיג֖וּהָ בֵּ֥ין הַמְּצָרִֽים׃ס

passages.text: The roads to Zion mourn, because no one comes to her appointed feasts. All her gates are deserted; her priests groan, her maidens grieve, and she herself is bitter with anguish.
passages.sermon:
Zion is a city.
Zion is now in sorrow.
The roads to Zion mourn.
No one comes to Zion’s appointed feasts.
All the gates of Zion are deserted.
Her priests groan.
Her maidens grieve.
Zion herself feels bitter anguish.
passages.original: דַּרְכֵ֨י צִיּ֜וֹן אֲבֵל֗וֹת מִבְּלִי֙ בָּאֵ֣י מוֹעֵ֔ד כָּל־ שְׁעָרֶ֙יהָ֙ שֽׁוֹמֵמִ֔ין כֹּהֲנֶ֖יהָ נֶאֱנָחִ֑ים בְּתוּלֹתֶ֥יהָ נּוּג֖וֹת וְהִ֥יא מַר־ לָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: Her foes have become her masters; her enemies are at ease. For the LORD has brought her grief because of her many transgressions. Her children have gone away as captives before the enemy.
passages.sermon:
Judah’s enemies have become her rulers.
Her foes now have power over her.
Her enemies live in peace and security.
The LORD has caused Judah’s suffering.
The LORD did this because of Judah’s many sins.
Judah’s children have gone into captivity.
The enemy has taken her children away as prisoners.
passages.original: הָי֨וּ צָרֶ֤יהָ לְרֹאשׁ֙ אֹיְבֶ֣יהָ שָׁל֔וּ כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה הוֹגָ֖הּ עַ֣ל רֹב־ פְּשָׁעֶ֑יהָ עוֹלָלֶ֛יהָ הָלְכ֥וּ שְׁבִ֖י לִפְנֵי־ צָֽר׃ס

passages.text: All the splendor has departed from the Daughter of Zion. Her princes are like deer that find no pasture; they lack the strength to flee in the face of the hunter.
passages.sermon:
The Daughter of Zion has lost all her splendor.
Her leaders are weak.
They are like deer that cannot find grass to eat.
They have no strength.
They cannot run away from those who chase them.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א מִן־ בַּת צִיּ֖וֹן כָּל־ הֲדָרָ֑הּ הָי֣וּ שָׂרֶ֗יהָ כְּאַיָּלִים֙ לֹא־ מָצְא֣וּ מִרְעֶ֔ה וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ בְלֹא־ כֹ֖חַ לִפְנֵ֥י רוֹדֵֽף׃ס

passages.text: In the days of her affliction and wandering Jerusalem remembers all the treasures that were hers in days of old. When her people fell into enemy hands she received no help. Her enemies looked upon her, laughing at her downfall.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
Jerusalem suffers affliction and wandering.
During this time, Jerusalem remembers her past.
She remembers all her treasures from long ago.
Her people fell into the hands of enemies.
No one helped her.
Her enemies saw her.
Her enemies laughed at her downfall.
passages.original: זָֽכְרָ֣ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם יְמֵ֤י עָנְיָהּ֙ וּמְרוּדֶ֔יהָ כֹּ֚ל מַחֲמֻדֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָי֖וּ מִ֣ימֵי קֶ֑דֶם בִּנְפֹ֧ל עַמָּ֣הּ בְּיַד־ צָ֗ר וְאֵ֤ין עוֹזֵר֙ לָ֔הּ רָא֣וּהָ צָרִ֔ים שָׂחֲק֖וּ עַ֥ל מִשְׁבַּתֶּֽהָ׃ס

passages.text: Jerusalem has sinned greatly; therefore she has become an object of scorn. All who honored her now despise her, for they have seen her nakedness; she herself groans and turns away.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
Jerusalem sinned greatly.
Because of this, people scorn Jerusalem.
People once honored Jerusalem.
Now, these people despise Jerusalem.
They saw Jerusalem’s shame.
Jerusalem groans.
Jerusalem turns away.
passages.original: חֵ֤טְא חָֽטְאָה֙ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם עַל־ כֵּ֖ן לְנִידָ֣ה הָיָ֑תָה כָּֽל־ מְכַבְּדֶ֤יהָ הִזִּיל֙וּהָ֙ כִּי־ רָא֣וּ עֶרְוָתָ֔הּ גַּם־ הִ֥יא נֶאֶנְחָ֖ה וַתָּ֥שָׁב אָחֽוֹר׃ס

passages.text: Her uncleanness stains her skirts; she did not consider her end. Her downfall was astounding; there was no one to comfort her. Look, O LORD, on my affliction, for the enemy has triumphed!
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem is a city.
Uncleanness stains the skirts of Jerusalem.
Jerusalem did not think about her future.
Her fall was astonishing.
No one comforts her.
O LORD, see my suffering.
The enemy has become great.
passages.original: טֻמְאָתָ֣הּ בְּשׁוּלֶ֗יהָ לֹ֤א זָֽכְרָה֙ אַחֲרִיתָ֔הּ וַתֵּ֣רֶד פְּלָאִ֔ים אֵ֥ין מְנַחֵ֖ם לָ֑הּ רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ עָנְיִ֔י כִּ֥י הִגְדִּ֖יל אוֹיֵֽב׃ס

passages.text: The adversary has seized all her treasures. For she has seen the nations enter her sanctuary— those You had forbidden to enter Your assembly.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem has an adversary.
This adversary has taken all her treasures.
Jerusalem saw foreign nations enter her sanctuary.
God had commanded that these nations must not enter His assembly.
The nations entered anyway.
They entered the place God had set apart.
They entered even though God had forbidden it.
passages.original: יָדוֹ֙ פָּ֣רַשׂ צָ֔ר עַ֖ל כָּל־ מַחֲמַדֶּ֑יהָ כִּֽי־ רָאֲתָ֤ה גוֹיִם֙ בָּ֣אוּ מִקְדָּשָׁ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר צִוִּ֔יתָה לֹא־ יָבֹ֥אוּ בַקָּהָ֖ל לָֽךְ׃ס

passages.text: All her people groan as they search for bread. They have traded their treasures for food to keep themselves alive. Look, O LORD, and consider, for I have become despised.
passages.sermon:
All her people groan.
They search for bread.
They give away their treasures for food.
They do this to keep themselves alive.
Look, O LORD.
See my condition.
I have become despised.
passages.original: כָּל־ עַמָּ֤הּ נֶאֱנָחִים֙ מְבַקְּשִׁ֣ים לֶ֔חֶם נָתְנ֧וּ מַחֲמוֹדֵּיהֶם בְּאֹ֖כֶל לְהָשִׁ֣יב נָ֑פֶשׁ רְאֵ֤ה יְהוָה֙ וְֽהַבִּ֔יטָה כִּ֥י הָיִ֖יתִי זוֹלֵלָֽה׃ס

passages.text: Is this nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look around and see! Is there any sorrow like mine, which was inflicted on me, which the LORD made me suffer on the day of His fierce anger?
passages.sermon:
I am speaking to everyone who passes by.
I ask you to look at me.
I ask you to see my pain.
No one has sorrow like my sorrow.
The LORD gave me this suffering.
He did this to me on the day of His fierce anger.
passages.original: ל֣וֹא אֲלֵיכֶם֮ כָּל־ עֹ֣בְרֵי דֶרֶךְ֒ הַבִּ֣יטוּ וּרְא֗וּ אִם־ יֵ֤שׁ מַכְאוֹב֙ כְּמַכְאֹבִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר עוֹלַ֖ל לִ֑י אֲשֶׁר֙ הוֹגָ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה בְּי֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃ס

passages.text: He sent fire from on high, and it overpowered my bones. He spread a net for my feet and turned me back. He made me desolate, faint all the day long.
passages.sermon:
The Lord sent fire from above.
The fire entered my bones.
The fire overpowered me.
The Lord spread a net for my feet.
He trapped me.
He turned me back from my path.
He made me alone and empty.
I felt weak all day.
passages.original: מִמָּר֛וֹם שָֽׁלַח־ אֵ֥שׁ בְּעַצְמֹתַ֖י וַיִּרְדֶּ֑נָּה פָּרַ֨שׂ רֶ֤שֶׁת לְרַגְלַי֙ הֱשִׁיבַ֣נִי אָח֔וֹר נְתָנַ֙נִי֙ שֹֽׁמֵמָ֔ה כָּל־ הַיּ֖וֹם דָּוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: My transgressions are bound into a yoke, knit together by His hand; they are draped over my neck, and the Lord has broken my strength. He has delivered me into the hands of those I cannot withstand.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is Jerusalem.
Jerusalem has sinned.
Her transgressions are many.
God has taken her sins.
He has tied them together.
He has made them into a yoke.
He has placed this yoke on her neck.
This yoke is heavy.
It weighs her down.
The Lord has broken her strength.
She cannot resist.
The Lord has handed her over.
He has given her into the hands of enemies.
She cannot stand against them.
passages.original: נִשְׂקַד֩ עֹ֨ל פְּשָׁעַ֜י בְּיָד֗וֹ יִשְׂתָּֽרְג֛וּ עָל֥וּ עַל־ צַוָּארִ֖י הִכְשִׁ֣יל כֹּחִ֑י נְתָנַ֣נִי אֲדֹנָ֔י בִּידֵ֖י לֹא־ אוּכַ֥ל קֽוּם׃ס

passages.text: The Lord has rejected all the mighty men in my midst; He has summoned an army against me to crush my young warriors. Like grapes in a winepress, the Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
passages.sermon:
The Lord is the God of Israel.
The Lord has rejected all the mighty men among us.
He has removed every strong warrior from our midst.
The Lord has called an appointed time against me.
He has summoned an army to destroy my young men.
The Lord has crushed my young warriors.
The Lord has trampled the Virgin Daughter of Judah.
He has pressed her down like grapes in a winepress.
passages.original: סִלָּ֨ה כָל־ אַבִּירַ֤י׀ אֲדֹנָי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י קָרָ֥א עָלַ֛י מוֹעֵ֖ד לִשְׁבֹּ֣ר בַּחוּרָ֑י גַּ֚ת דָּרַ֣ךְ אֲדֹנָ֔י לִבְתוּלַ֖ת בַּת־ יְהוּדָֽה׃ס

passages.text: For these things I weep; my eyes flow with tears. For there is no one nearby to comfort me, no one to revive my soul. My children are destitute because the enemy has prevailed.
passages.sermon:
Jerusalem speaks in this passage.
Jerusalem suffers greatly.
Jerusalem says, “I weep for these things.”
Tears fall from my eyes.
No one is near to comfort me.
No one can restore my soul.
My children are desolate.
The enemy has become strong.
The enemy has overcome us.
My children suffer because of this.
passages.original: עַל־ אֵ֣לֶּה׀ אֲנִ֣י בוֹכִיָּ֗ה עֵינִ֤י׀ עֵינִי֙ יֹ֣רְדָה מַּ֔יִם כִּֽי־ רָחַ֥ק מִמֶּ֛נִּי מְנַחֵ֖ם מֵשִׁ֣יב נַפְשִׁ֑י הָי֤וּ בָנַי֙ שֽׁוֹמֵמִ֔ים כִּ֥י גָבַ֖ר אוֹיֵֽב׃ס

passages.text: Zion stretches out her hands, but there is no one to comfort her. The LORD has decreed against Jacob that his neighbors become his foes. Jerusalem has become an unclean thing among them.
passages.sermon:
Zion stretches out her hands.
No one comforts her.
The LORD has commanded against Jacob.
He made Jacob’s neighbors become his enemies.
Jerusalem has become unclean among them.
passages.original: פֵּֽרְשָׂ֨ה צִיּ֜וֹן בְּיָדֶ֗יהָ אֵ֤ין מְנַחֵם֙ לָ֔הּ צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לְיַעֲקֹ֖ב סְבִיבָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו הָיְתָ֧ה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם לְנִדָּ֖ה בֵּינֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: The LORD is righteous, for I have rebelled against His command. Listen, all you people; look upon my suffering. My young men and maidens have gone into captivity.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is righteous.
I have rebelled against His command.
All people, listen to me.
See my suffering.
My young men have gone into captivity.
My maidens have gone into captivity.
passages.original: צַדִּ֥יק ה֛וּא יְהוָ֖ה כִּ֣י פִ֣יהוּ מָרִ֑יתִי שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א כָל־ עַמִּים וּרְאוּ֙ מַכְאֹבִ֔י בְּתוּלֹתַ֥י וּבַחוּרַ֖י הָלְכ֥וּ בַשֶּֽׁבִי׃ס

passages.text: I called out to my lovers, but they have betrayed me. My priests and elders perished in the city while they searched for food to keep themselves alive.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is Jerusalem.
Jerusalem called out to her lovers.
Her lovers betrayed her.
Her priests died in the city.
Her elders died in the city.
They searched for food.
They wanted to keep themselves alive.
passages.original: קָרָ֤אתִי לַֽמְאַהֲבַי֙ הֵ֣מָּה רִמּ֔וּנִי כֹּהֲנַ֥י וּזְקֵנַ֖י בָּעִ֣יר גָּוָ֑עוּ כִּֽי־ בִקְשׁ֥וּ אֹ֙כֶל֙ לָ֔מוֹ וְיָשִׁ֖יבוּ אֶת־ נַפְשָֽׁם׃ס

passages.text: See, O LORD, how distressed I am! I am churning within; my heart is pounding within me, for I have been most rebellious. Outside, the sword bereaves; inside, there is death.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is suffering greatly.
The speaker calls to the LORD.
The speaker says, "See, O LORD, I am in distress."
The speaker feels pain deep inside.
The speaker's heart is troubled within.
The speaker's heart turns over inside.
The speaker says, "I have been very rebellious."
Outside, the sword kills people.
Inside, there is death.
passages.original: רְאֵ֨ה יְהוָ֤ה כִּֽי־ צַר־ לִי֙ מֵעַ֣י חֳמַרְמָ֔רוּ נֶהְפַּ֤ךְ לִבִּי֙ בְּקִרְבִּ֔י כִּ֥י מָר֖וֹ מָרִ֑יתִי מִח֥וּץ שִׁכְּלָה־ חֶ֖רֶב בַּבַּ֥יִת כַּמָּֽוֶת׃ס

passages.text: People have heard my groaning, but there is no one to comfort me. All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that You have caused it. May You bring the day You have announced, so that they may become like me.
passages.sermon:
People have heard me groan.
No one comforts me.
All my enemies have heard about my trouble.
They are glad because You, Lord, have done this.
You have announced a day of judgment.
Let that day come.
Let my enemies become like me.
passages.original: שָׁמְע֞וּ כִּ֧י נֶאֱנָחָ֣ה אָ֗נִי אֵ֤ין מְנַחֵם֙ לִ֔י כָּל־ אֹ֨יְבַ֜י שָׁמְע֤וּ רָֽעָתִי֙ שָׂ֔שׂוּ כִּ֥י אַתָּ֖ה עָשִׂ֑יתָ הֵבֵ֥אתָ יוֹם־ קָרָ֖אתָ וְיִֽהְי֥וּ כָמֽוֹנִי׃ס

passages.text: Let all their wickedness come before You, and deal with them as You have dealt with me because of all my transgressions. For my groans are many, and my heart is faint.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is suffering because of their sins.
The speaker addresses God.
The speaker asks God to see all the evil deeds of their enemies.
The speaker asks God to bring these evil deeds before Him.
The speaker asks God to punish their enemies.
The speaker wants God to punish them just as He punished the speaker.
God punished the speaker because of the speaker’s many sins.
The speaker says they groan often.
The speaker says their heart is weak.
passages.original: תָּבֹ֨א כָל־ רָעָתָ֤ם לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ וְעוֹלֵ֣ל לָ֔מוֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עוֹלַ֛לְתָּ לִ֖י עַ֣ל כָּל־ פְּשָׁעָ֑י כִּֽי־ רַבּ֥וֹת אַנְחֹתַ֖י וְלִבִּ֥י דַוָּֽי׃פ
